message: Search, finder and filters are correct and tested (TestSearch/TestFuzzy/TestFinder* pass; CLI verified). Fix: shp search --json emits PascalCase keys (ID, Kind, Status, Title, Snippet, Score) while every other --json output uses lowercase (model.Item: id, kind, status, title). Add json tags (id, kind, status, title, snippet,omitempty, score) in internal/cli/search.go before agents depend on it; optionally add a label-match case to TestSearch.

Read working.go diff: spinner() walks each pulse's parent chain with a cycle guard, so story/epic spin; only caller is the tree row render. TestWorkingSpinnerMarksAncestors covers ancestors, non-path items and a collapsed epic; passes.

Read tui.go/mouse.go diff: wheel sets freeTree, clampOffset only bounds-clamps while set, any KeyMsg or tree click clears it; clickTree maps rows via offset so clicks stay accurate. TestWheelScrollsTreeWithoutMovingSelection (scroll, reload keeps offset, j resyncs) passes. Manual trackpad check remains for the human.
